newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile awards extra cobalt to Minor Metals.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile awards extra cobalt to Minor Metals.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said it also sold cobalt to trader Minor Metals in the award announced March 25.

Stockpile's statement did not say if additional cobalt above the 1.1 million lbs would be given to Minor Metals or if less material would be distributed to the seven winning bids announced late Tuesday.
Stockpile officials were not immediately available for comment.
Originally, Stockpile said it awarded 1.1 million lbs of lower grade cobalt to seven named companies, a list which did not include Minor Metals.

The New Jersey-based trader, also known as Metal Resources Group Limited, filed two protests to the General Accounting Office last week, complaining that Stockpile had potentially divulged trade secrets about the company to other cobalt bidders.
Stockpile officials have dismissed the allegations.
